t: Mah hem haddebarim hashsheruyim bechatzer sheenam oserim
s: Mah hem haddebarim hashsheruyim bechatzer sheenam oserim ubo h' seipim: mirpeset arukka shellipne haaliyyot veomedet bechatzer veolin lah besullam, ubene haaliyyot yotzein lah derek pitchehem happetuchim lah veyoredin mimmenna besullam lechatzer, veoberim lirshut harabbim — hare mirpeset zo laaliyyot kechatzer lebattim, veim lo erebu yachad asurim lehotzi lah kelim sheshshabetu baaliyyot, shebbene haaliyyot oserim otah zeh al zeh, hoil vehi meshammeshet lekullam, vekullam petuchim lah kemo habbattim lechatzer. Abal en tzarik leareb im bene hechatzer, sheap shehem erebu lirshut harabbim derek hechatzer enam oserim otah alehem, hoil veenan petuchim lah ella lemirpeset, usetam mirpeset gaboah asara, vekol gaboah asara reshut bipne atzmo hu umuchleqet mereshut sheetzlah. Umikkol maqom im ratzu leareb im bene hechatzer, kede sheggam hem yihyu muttarim lehotzi lechatzer kelim sheshshabetu baaliyyotehem — yekolim leareb al yede hassullam shemmechatzer lemirpeset, shehu niddon kepetach, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"b, vahare hen keb' chatzerot upetach benehen, sheim ratzu meorbim yachad veim ratzu mearebet kol achat leatzmah. Veap shehassullam torat petach alayv, ap al pi ken en haaliyyot chashubot kiptuchot lechatzer, lepi shehassullam en torat petach alayv ella lehaqel, sheyyekolim leareb yachad al yede sullam shebbenehen kemo al yede petach, abal lo lehachamir. Bammeh debarim amurim shebbene hammirpeset dehaynu bene haaliyyot enam oserim bechatzer? Kesheyyearebu hem yachad, shehem muttarim bemirpeset shellahem, vahare zo regel hammutteret bimqomah sheenah oseret shello bimqomah, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sha"ch. Abal im lo erebu, kevan shehem asurim bemirpeset shellahem — hare zeh regel haasura bimqomah veoseret shello bimqomah ad sheyyearebu sham, kemo sheyyitbaer sham:

Im erebu bene hammirpeset leatzman velo erebu im bene hechatzer, veyesh bechatzer tel o ammud shehu shel bene hechatzer veshel bene hammirpeset beshuttaput, ushenehem mishtammeshim bo bechol — im hu gaboah asara miqqarqait hechatzer veeno namuk asara mimmirpeset, notenim oto libne hammirpeset, shehem muttarim lehishtammesh bo beshabbat bekelim sheshshabetu baaliyyot, velo bene hechatzer bekelim sheshshabetu babbayit, lepi shellahem hu tashmisho benachat, kevan shehu tok asara lahem, velibne hechatzer tashmisho beqasheh, sheen derek lehishtammesh bo bechatzer ella lekattep alayv massoy kabed, vekevan sheggaboah asara — eno rauy lekittup massoy ella beqoshi. Vekol shellezeh tashmisho benachat ulezeh tashmisho beqasheh — notenim oto lezeh shebbenachat. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehu samuk lammirpeset. Abal im hu muplag mikkenegdah d' tepachim, kevan sheenah yekola lehishtammesh bo ella al yede zeriqa baavir berochab d' tepachim — hare zeh gam ken tashmisho beqasheh. Velaken oserim zeh al zeh, ushenehem asurim bo bekelim sheshshabetu babbayit ad sheyyearebu. Veim hu tok asara lishnehem, o yoter measara lishnehem — im hu muplag mikkeneged hammirpeset d', notenim oto lechatzer, shettashmisho lah benachat yoter millammirpeset. Veim eno muplag d', shenehem asurim. Veim hu tok asara lechatzer, veyoter measara lammirpeset — notenim oto lechatzer bekol inyan, ap al pi sheeno muplag d' mikkeneged hammirpeset:

Bor shebbechatzer shel bene hechatzer vehammirpeset beshuttaput, umaqqipato chulya gaboah y' usemuka lammirpeset, ap al pi shebbene hechatzer mishtammeshim bo beshilshul ubizriqa, shezzoreqin deli lemala min hachulya umeshalshelin oto labbor, ubene mirpeset mishtammeshim beshilshul bilbad — ap al pi ken oserim zeh al zeh lemallot bidli sheshshabat bebeto o baaliyyot, o lehabi hammayim bekelim qallim lehatzniam shamma, veen notenim oto libne hammirpeset, hoil vegam lahem tashmisho beqasheh al yede shilshul y' tepachim. Vaapillu im habbor male mayim ad gobah hachulya samuk lammirpeset — asur, mishshum gezera shemma yachseru hammayim beshabbat veyishtammeshu bo kebattechilla. Abal im haya habbor male bedabar sheeno nittal beshabbat — hare hu keammud o tel gaboah asara mechatzer vetok asara lammirpeset, shennotenim oto lammirpeset im eno muplag mikkenegdah d':

Hayeta matztzeba gaboah d' tepachim lipne hammirpeset — en hammirpeset oseret al bene hechatzer apillu tel veammud hassemuka lah, shekkevan sheasu hepseq lipne hammirpeset, gillu datam shessillequ atzman mehechatzer:

Zizin hayyotzein min hakketalim vehem mibbene hechatzer vehaaliyyot beshuttaput, kol shehu lematta measara — hare zeh nechshab mehechatzer ubene hechatzer mishtammeshim bo, vekol shehu betok y' tepachim haelyonim hassemukim laaliyya — anshe aliyya mishtammeshim bo. Vehannishar ben asara hattachtonim ad techillat asara haelyonim min hazzizim hayyotzeim — shenehem asurim lehishtammesh bahem bekelim sheshshabetu babbattim, ella im ken erebu yachad bene hechatzer im bene haaliyyot:
